Money and finances

Money and finances

Managing your money, debt and investments, planning for retirement and protecting yourself from consumer fraud.

Most requested

  • Canada's response to U.S. tariffs
  • Housing
  • Student loans
  • Credit report and scores
  • Mortgages
  • Make a budget
  • Set up or change direct deposit
  • Find a bankruptcy or insolvency record

Services and information

Managing your money

Housing, budgeting, banking, money transfers, insurance and planning your finances at different life stages.

Consumer affairs

Solutions for everyday consumer topics like complaint resolution and consumer protection.

Debt and borrowing

Managing debt, credit cards, mortgages, loans, lines of credit, credit reports and more.

Education funding

Scholarships, paying for your education, RESPs, budgeting tips and paying off student debt.

Pensions and retirement

Retirement planning, public and registered pensions, RRSPs, RRIFs, retirement income calculator and more.

Financial tools and calculators

Tools to help you choose a bank account and credit card, including budget and mortgage calculators.

Savings and investments

Savings and investment types, setting goals and choosing a financial advisor.

Taxes

Tax information for individuals, businesses, charities and trusts.

Financial literacy programs

Educational materials to help students and adults increase their financial knowledge and skills.

Business financing and support

Grants and contributions, loans, tax credits, wage subsidies and other business support.

Protection from frauds and scams

Identity theft, types of fraud, counterfeit money and other threats or scams.

Government finances

How the government manages its finances through the federal budget, planned spending and reports on expenses.

Financial and money services regulation

Plan and trust administration, financial transaction reporting, the regulation of financial institutions and more.

Insolvency

Consumer proposals, bankruptcy and how to find a Licensed Insolvency Trustee.

Features

Canada-United States: Overview and federal supports

All Canada-U.S. support and information geared to Canadian businesses and individuals, including on importing, local products, travelling, and more.

Buying, selling and supporting Canadian

Find information on Made in Canada labels, how to buy Canadian and the benefits of shopping and travelling in Canada.

Beware of suspicious messages, report them!

Learn how to recognize suspicious text messages and report them safely to help protect yourself.

Canada’s government surplus marketplace

Shop GCSurplus for affordable government surplus items (furniture, vehicles and more) and support sustainability nationwide.
